result.title: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
result.summary: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用表示论刻画线性循环 SSM 的状态跟踪能力，证明对角实/复 SSM 只能跟踪交换群、可跟踪群的转移矩阵须按实/复/四元数分块，并提出加入四元数通道的 HyperSSM，在群任务上精确求解、泛化到 25 倍训练长度，且循环权重可直接解释（如陀螺仪标定、量子门旋转）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态能否记录输入顺序取决于转移矩阵的非交换结构」这一群论判据，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留关系与顺序信息、以及长度泛化的结构性预测提供可核查线索，四元数分块状态更新也可作为非交换潜状态的候选设计。
